about: Catalog for the APPS workspace (Zzz5-W9). Versions, sizes and SHA-256 come from each item's own manifest, never from this file. An item without a manifest that carries sha256 is listed but never offered for download. Kind 'gated' = file only for logged-in Verso users through edge function verso-apps; version and SHA-256 come from table verso_app_releases. Field 'group' (system | module) draws the VERSO SYSTEM APP / VERSO APP MODULES sections; kind 'planned' = listed, nothing to download yet. Field 'modules' = the parts of one installable app, shown when the row is opened (one install, many modules). Kind 'external' = a service of another company that Verso uses (search engine …): shown red, nothing to download, replaceable in its SETUP (field 'open' = the SETTINGS place) - every foreign service is its own separable module. Field 'tab' = layer: verso (VERSO SYSTEM, free, always) · recommended (Verso optional) · external (another company); old tabs third / third-system open EXTERNAL. Field 'sub' = sub-part of the layer (system, communication, viewers, media, search, apps, cloud, games, ai, data). Fields 'help' {what, how, limits}, 'support' {by, contact}, 'ack' = ❓ HELP of the row; 'required' = cannot be switched off (only changed in its SETUP).
